description: Machine-checkable dependency graph (target topology). Edge = depends-on / uses. Same O(1) rules as mcp_guard.

nodes.path: rlcd/src/main.cpp tlsCloud / tlsLua HTTP helpers (target: cloud_http module)
rlcd/src/ble_ctrl.cpp (D-pad + Nordic UART transport) + http_pad.cpp + pad_ctrl.cpp
rlcd/src/sensors.cpp (SHTC3 + battery: RLCD ADC / TG28 fuel gauge)
demos/ (Lua apps — data, not a plugin)

notes: Compose (device_runtime / control_plane / script_engine) may wire plugins; plugin→plugin edges are forbidden.
AS-IS debt: panel/audio/ble_pad/sensors are compiled into one firmware and registered monolithically in script_engine — target is PlatformIO env plugin sets (see PLUGIN-RUNTIME.md).
arm plugin: RoArm STS stack (`esp32-roarm-m2`) + invoke/Lua passthrough; not linked into panel products.

claude_buddy: Claude desktop Hardware Buddy protocol (newline JSON). No BLE dependency: device_runtime pipes ble_pad's Nordic UART bytes into it and hands it the PanelDisplay contract for the prompt card.
Battery badge: sensors fills OcBattery (contracts); device_runtime passes it to panel, which overlays it on every flush. No sensors→panel edge.
vision_path is host-side pathway B (frame→objects+empties); no edges to ESP plugins — Agent may orchestrate.
jev_servo_path is host-side pathway C (JEV per-joint intervals → one cloud arm.stream); consumes vision state; no plugin edges.
demos/ are cloud-deployed Lua sources, not firmware plugins.
control_plane filters invoke tools by device capabilities[] reported in /status.
